fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rotten Parting
fusions.desc: Hurls a foul glob that hits the first enemy in its path for 26 damage and splashes everything within 3 tiles for 80% of that, leaving the target [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Back
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 55% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Notice Taken
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
